mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_family ef WHERE ef.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id from employee e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INFO employee_family( employee_id, family_name, family_relation, birth_date, job, company_name, living_together, dependent, disabled ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{familyName}, #{familyRelation}, #{birthDate}, #{job}, #{companyName}, #{livingTogether}, #{dependent}, #{disabled} )
